lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters in three roughly parallel horizontal rows along the lateral flank, extending posteriorly from the pectoral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, resulting in a grid-like distribution of luminance maxima.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge on the upper flank showing a distinct luminance gradient with highlights on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-luminance spotting visible on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin.
